'''''Elatine hydropiper''''', known as the '''eight-stamened waterwort''',<ref>{{Cite web|last=Zicha|first=Ondrej|title=BioLib: Biological library: ''Elatine hydropiper''|url=https://www.biolib.cz/en/taxon/id3631/|access-date=2021-11-20|website=www.biolib.cz}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Elatine hydropiper L.|url=https://www.gbif.org/species/9076200|access-date=2021-11-20|website=www.gbif.org|language=en}}</ref> is a species of [[flowering plant]] belonging to the family [[Elatinaceae]].<ref name="POWO">{{cite web |title=Elatine hydropiper L. {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:324690-1 |website=Plants of the World Online |access-date=10 February 2021 |language=en}}</ref> 

Its native range is Europe to [[Russian Far East]].<ref name="POWO" />
[[File:Elatine hydropiper distribution in Poland.svg|thumb|''Distribution map of Elatine hydropiper in Poland (in regions) (source: A. Zając & M. Zając (red.)'']]
It was first described by Swedish botanist [[Carl Linnaeus]] in 1753.<ref name="POWO" /><ref name="l">{{cite Q|Q21856106| url=https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/358385|pages=367}}</ref>
